propositions: scc_loc.analyze() invokes scc via subprocess and parses JSON output to produce AnalyzerResult with loc payload containing per-file LOC keyed by repo-relative POSIX paths
scc JSON is two-level (data list of language groups, each with Files array of {Code, Location} entries) and must be flattened to extract individual file LOC values
analyze() returns Unavailable (not zeros) when scc binary is missing, subprocess exits non-zero, stdout is empty, or JSON is unparseable
successful empty scc output ([] result) returns AnalyzerResult with empty files dict and max_loc=0, not Unavailable
scc_loc.py remains self-contained with injectable run parameter for testability and no dependency on grounding layer
module defines _ACCRUING_SINCE constant matching existing metrics reader modules (2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00)
